tools.name: get_latest_reset
tools.description: The most recent global Gemini quota reset in Google Antigravity: when it happened (UTC), who it covered, the original post, and how long ago it was.

tools.name: did_gemini_reset_today
tools.description: Whether a global Gemini quota reset happened in the last 24 hours, and whether one happened 'today' in the given time zone.

tools.name: list_resets
tools.description: Global Gemini quota resets in Google Antigravity, newest first, with scope, quote and original post. Optionally include limit changes that were not resets.

tools.name: get_reset_stats
tools.description: Count of global Gemini resets since the first one, average and median gap, shortest and longest gap, last five gaps and resets per month. Past gaps are not a schedule.

tools.name: get_next_api_reset
tools.description: When the Gemini API / AI Studio requests-per-day quota next resets (midnight Pacific Time), shown in the given time zone. This is the only fixed daily Gemini reset.

tools.name: get_quota_rules
tools.description: The normal (non-global) refresh rule for a Gemini product, whether global resets apply to it, where to check your remaining quota, and the official source.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_latest_reset, list_resets · Public sink: get_latest_reset, list_resets · Destructive: get_latest_reset, did_gemini_reset_today, get_reset_stats, get_next_api_reset.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_latest_reset, list_resets · Public sink: get_latest_reset, list_resets · Destructive: get_latest_reset, did_gemini_reset_today, get_reset_stats, get_next_api_reset

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
